title: Bringing dark web intelligence into the AI era
description: Dark web monitoring is fraught with false positives producing unnecessary noise and distractions to those tasked with using these tools. Google Threat Intelligence is using Gemini to help filter through the noise and provide relevant dark web intelligence with industry changing accuracy. Internal tests show Google Threat Intelligence can analyze millions of daily external events - with 98% accuracy.
